package.name: dual_arm_object_task
package.description: C4.3 S4 -- the anchored object task and the frozen object trajectory. Extracted verbatim from dual_arm_transport_mock (C4.3 S3 W3/W4) so that the production controller can build the object task without depending on a mock package. Dependency direction: dual_arm_transport_mock -> this package -> {dual_arm_kinematics, Eigen3, yaml-cpp}. This package must never depend on moveit, on the QP, or on the mock.
